WITH slik_map AS (
    SELECT
        trace_id,
        get_json_object(header_data, '$.CreditUserId') as credit_user_id,
        get_json_object(header_data, '$.PlatformUserId') as platform_user_id,
        get_json_object(header_data, '$.FlowNo') as flow_no,
        get_json_object(req_data, '$.IdNumber') as ktp_no,
        get_json_object(resp_raw_data, '$.status') as status,
        get_json_object(resp_raw_data, '$.error') as is_error,
        substr(create_time,1,10) as create_time,
        explode(
        from_json(get_json_object(resp_raw_data, '$.SlikReports'), 'map<string,string>')
        ) AS (reference_number, value_str)
    FROM risk.ods__credit_risk_datafetch_id_db__identity_data_tab__df
    WHERE grass_date = '${ds}' AND data_source_name = 'CBI' AND datediff(date(grass_date), date(substr(create_time, 1, 10))) <= 90
    ),
non_empty_report AS (
    SELECT
        trace_id,
        credit_user_id,
        platform_user_id,
        flow_no,
        ktp_no,
        reference_number as report_no,
        status,
        is_error,
        create_time,
        get_json_object(value_str, '$.result.BureauReport.ReportInfo.RINF_ReportDateTime') as report_update_time,
        value_str
    FROM slik_map
    WHERE value_str IS NOT NULL AND length(trim(value_str)) > 2  -- 简单判断非空json字符串
        AND get_json_object(value_str, '$.error') <> true 
    ),
active_loan_data_tmp AS (
        SELECT
            trace_id,
            credit_user_id,
            platform_user_id,
            flow_no,
            ktp_no,
            report_no,
            status,
            is_error,
            create_time,
            report_update_time,
            from_json(
            get_json_object(value_str, '$.result.BureauReport.CreditFacilityDetail.CREDIT_ActiveFacility_AsDebtor.CREDIT_ActiveFacility_AsDebtorList'),
            'array<string>'
            ) AS loan
        FROM non_empty_report
    ),
closed_loan_data_tmp AS (
        SELECT
            trace_id,
            credit_user_id,
            platform_user_id,
            flow_no,
            ktp_no,
            report_no,
            status,
            is_error,
            create_time,
            report_update_time,
            from_json(
            get_json_object(value_str, '$.result.BureauReport.CreditFacilityDetail.CREDIT_ClosedFacility_AsDebtor.CREDIT_ClosedFacility_AsDebtorList'),
            'array<string>'
            ) AS loan
        FROM non_empty_report
    ),
active_loan_data AS (
    SELECT 
        trace_id,
        credit_user_id,
        platform_user_id,
        flow_no,
        ktp_no,
        report_no,
        status,
        is_error,
        create_time,
        report_update_time,
        explode(loan) AS loan_record
    FROM active_loan_data_tmp
    WHERE loan IS NOT NULL
    ),
closed_loan_data AS (
    SELECT 
        trace_id,
        credit_user_id,
        platform_user_id,
        flow_no,
        ktp_no,
        report_no,
        status,
        is_error,
        create_time,
        report_update_time,
        explode(loan) AS loan_record
    FROM closed_loan_data_tmp
    WHERE loan IS NOT NULL
    ),
loan_records AS (
    SELECT 
        trace_id,
        credit_user_id,
        platform_user_id,
        flow_no,
        ktp_no,
        report_no,
        status,
        is_error,
        create_time,
        report_update_time,
        get_json_object(loan_record, '$.CREDIT_ActiveFacility_AsDebtorList_Item') as loan_record
    FROM active_loan_data
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 
        trace_id,
        credit_user_id,
        platform_user_id,
        flow_no,
        ktp_no,
        report_no,
        status,
        is_error,
        create_time,
        report_update_time,
        get_json_object(loan_record, '$.CREDIT_ClosedFacility_AsDebtorList_Item') as loan_record
    FROM closed_loan_data
),
final_tab as (
SELECT 
  trace_id,
  credit_user_id,
  platform_user_id,
  flow_no,
  ktp_no,
  report_no,
  status,
  is_error,
  create_time,
  report_update_time,
  NULL as reporter_ljk_id,
  get_json_object(loan_record, '$.CREDIT_Creditor') as reporter,
  get_json_object(loan_record, '$.CREDIT_Condition') as condition,
  NULL as condition_id,
  NULL as quality,
